item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po a khrid kyis thun 'tshams bco lnga
item.coloph: de ltar man ngag khrid kyis (kyi) go rim lag len thun 'tshams (mtshams) dang chas pas (bcas pa) rje ri khrod pa yab sras brgyud par (rgyud pa) dang bcas pa'i mdzad srol/ 'gro mgon yor (g.yor)me dang mtshan ldan blo gros rin po che'i thugs dgongs/ mnyam med 'dul ba rin po che'i zhal gdams phyag len ji lta ba la/ lung dang man ngag gi skabs sbyar/ nyams myong gis gsal btab te cung zad gsal zhing go bde bar dpe thob don thob kyi tshul du/ snyigs ma'i bru ('gru) sgom rgyal ba g.yung drung la/ rin chen spungs pa mkhar sna'i brag la bkod pa'i/ rtse gcig nyams len pa 'dru ('bru) sgom sbyin pa 'od zer gyis bskul te/ 'gal 'khrul bshags cing (shing) dge ba dbyings su bsngo/ dpag rang dgar spel cing sgrin bu 'di bslad nas/ med 'gro ba'i don du gyur par shog/ skal ldan khrid tshar sgom phrug ma yin pa/ dam la 'gal lo bka' rgya ma bshig cig/ zhes bya ste man ngag rin po che khrid kyi rim pa rdzogs so//
